diff --git a/repro_pep695.py b/repro_pep695.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..c7fdf6bf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro_pep695.py
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+
+import types
+from typing import Union, List, Any
+from fastapi import UploadFile
+from fastapi._compat.shared import (
+    is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation,
+    is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation,
+    is_bytes_sequence_annotation,
+    is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation,
+)
+
+# PEP 695 Type Alias
+type BytesAlias = bytes
+type OptionalBytesAlias = Union[bytes, None]
+type BytesSeqAlias = List[bytes]
+type OptionalBytesSeqAlias = Union[List[bytes], None]
+
+type UploadFileAlias = UploadFile
+type OptionalUploadFileAlias = Union[UploadFile, None]
+type UploadFileSeqAlias = List[UploadFile]
+type OptionalUploadFileSeqAlias = Union[List[UploadFile], None]
+
+def test_bytes():
+    assert is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation(BytesAlias) is True
+    assert is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation(OptionalBytesAlias) is True
+    assert is_bytes_sequence_annotation(BytesSeqAlias) is True
+    assert is_bytes_sequence_annotation(OptionalBytesSeqAlias) is True
+
+def test_uploadfile():
+    assert is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation(UploadFileAlias) is True
+    assert is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation(OptionalUploadFileAlias) is True
+    assert is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation(UploadFileSeqAlias) is True
+    assert is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation(OptionalUploadFileSeqAlias) is True
+
+def test_negative():
+    type IntAlias = int
+    assert is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation(IntAlias) is False
+    assert is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation(IntAlias) is False
+    assert is_bytes_sequence_annotation(IntAlias) is False
+    assert is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation(IntAlias) is False
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_bytes()
+        test_uploadfile()
+        test_negative()
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
+        exit(1)

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+\"\"\"Automate release preparation.\"\"\"
+
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print(\"Usage: python scripts/release.py <version>\")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    version = sys.argv[1]
+
+    # Update fastapi/__init__.py
+    init_file = Path(\"fastapi/__init__.py\")
+    if not init_file.exists():
+        print(\"Error: fastapi/__init__.py not found\")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    content = init_file.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = \"{version}\"', content)
+    if new_content == content:
+        print(f\"Warning: __version__ not found or already set to {version} in fastapi/__init__.py\")
+    else:
+        init_file.write_text(new_content)
+        print(f\"Updated fastapi/__init__.py to version {version}\")
+
+    # Update docs/en/docs/release-notes.md
+    release_notes_file = Path(\"docs/en/docs/release-notes.md\")
+    if not release_notes_file.exists():
+        print(\"Error: docs/en/docs/release-notes.md not found\")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    lines = release_notes_file.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
+    new_lines = []
+    found_latest_changes = False
+    
+    for line in lines:
+        new_lines.append(line)
+        if line.strip() == \"## Latest Changes\":
+            new_lines.append(f\"\\n## {version}\\n\\n\")
+            found_latest_changes = True
+            
+    if not found_latest_changes:
+        print(\"Error: Could not find '## Latest Changes' in release-notes.md\")
+        sys.exit(1)
+        
+    release_notes_file.write_text(\"\".join(new_lines))
+    print(f\"Added version {version} to release-notes.md\")
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    main()
